findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: scan_ai_visibility · Private data: scan_ai_visibility · Public sink: scan_ai_visibility, get_visibility_report.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: scan_ai_visibility · Private data: scan_ai_visibility · Public sink: scan_ai_visibility, get_visibility_report

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "scan_ai_visibility" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
